name: prompt-trials
description: Run recorded prompt snapshots against candidate models and compare results (promptfoo-based).

scripts.eval: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo eval --no-cache -c
scripts.check: npm run -s eval -- suites/medium-digest/promptfooconfig.yaml && npm run -s eval -- suites/substack-digest/promptfooconfig.yaml && npm run -s eval -- suites/spotify-lane/promptfooconfig.yaml
